Opened draft quotation S00023 in Odoo Sales and clicked 'Confirm'; no confirmation dialog appeared and the page settled with the status bar now showing 'Sales Order' as the checked (disabled after confirmation) state, so it is a confirmed sales order. The reference in the breadcrumb/title is still S00023, and the amounts are unchanged: Untaxed Amount £10,780.00, TAX 20% £2,156.00, Total £12,936.00.

Opened confirmed sales order S00023 (customer 'fwod79-n3 Bench Customer') in Odoo Sales and cancelled it. Clicking the statusbar 'Cancel' button opened the native "Cancel Sales Order" wizard (offering 'Send and cancel' and 'Cancel'); I used the wizard's 'Cancel' action (button name action_cancel, i.e. cancel without sending the email). The wizard then closed and the page settled with the status bar showing 'Cancelled' as the checked state (radios: Cancelled [checked], Sales Order, Quotation Sent, Quotation) and a 'Set to Quotation' button now offered. Note: playhead mouse clicks on the wizard footer button did not register (element hit-testing was intercepted by the modal), so the action had to be triggered by focusing the button and pressing Enter — after which it worked.
